releases.highlight: The OH-6A/H500C checklist now follows the revised compact startup flow.
features: Adds explicit starter release, cockpit-lighting and before-takeoff light reminders to the streamlined OH-6A/H500C flow.

releases.highlight: A compact checklist is now available for Taog's Hangar's OH-6A Cayuse and Hughes 500C.
features: Adds a compact common startup, before-takeoff and shutdown checklist for the OH-6A Cayuse and Hughes 500C variants.

releases.highlight: The Windows companion now handles malformed simulator data and shutdown races more reliably.
fixes: Keeps receiving checklist updates after a malformed CommBus packet instead of entering a reconnect loop.
Reports incomplete checklist, group or item snapshots as protocol errors instead of partial status data.
Prevents rare shutdown races when SimConnect calls outlast the bounded exit wait.

releases.highlight: The H125 startup and lighting flow now follows the published aircraft procedures more closely.
features: Adds an explicit day-or-night instrument-lighting selection after battery activation.
Adds a dedicated Before Taxi group with a mandatory taxi-light reminder and separate landing-light choice.
fixes: Moves horn activation after the twist grip reaches FLIGHT and requires at least 340 rotor RPM.
Corrects the generator threshold from 60 to 67 percent N1.

releases.highlight: Release notes are now available directly inside the companion app.
features: Opens a fully offline, scrollable release history from a dedicated button.
Shows each release date, main highlight, features and fixes with the newest version first.

releases.highlight: Checklist state now reaches the companion app with less avoidable CommBus traffic.
fixes: Rate-limited spontaneous checklist snapshots and coalesced bursts to the latest state.
Reset checklist progress when switching between aircraft identities that share a checklist.

releases.highlight: The first Windows companion app shows live checklist status from MSFS 2024.
features: Distinguishes the simulator connection from receipt of EFB checklist state.
Shows aircraft, checklist, active group, next open item, progress and both app versions.
Ships as a directly launchable Windows EXE alongside the MSFS package.

releases.highlight: Checklist items can be confirmed from a keyboard or HOTAS button.
features: Confirms the next open item in the visible group through a user-bound MSFS control.

releases.highlight: The first native, offline VR Checklist app runs inside the MSFS 2024 EFB.
features: Introduced automatic aircraft selection and VR-first checklists for the G36, DA42 and MH-60.
